jobs.title: CLX Property Advocate, Liability
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What you're applying for

We're looking for a Property Claims Advocate, Liability to help us deliver fast, fair, and genuinely human claims experiences. You'll be the person our customers count on when things go wrong — investigating liability claims end to end, making smart coverage decisions, and explaining them clearly, without the jargon. This role sits within our Claims team, where ownership, empathy, and sharp judgment aren't nice-to-haves — they're the baseline.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.
